reviews.text: The N Seoul Tower Observatory has one of the best panoramic views in Seoul, offering panoramic views of the city through 360-degree glass windows. It boasts breathtaking scenery both day and night. You can enjoy a panoramic view of landmarks such as the Han River and surrounding mountains during the day, and a dazzling night view with endless city lights in the evening. The observation deck is well-maintained and has informative displays about major attractions and a revolving restaurant, adding to the luxurious atmosphere. Ticket prices may be a bit high, but the unforgettable skyline views and romantic atmosphere make it a must-visit. For the best experience, visit during sunset to watch the city change from day to night.

reviews.text:
This place is delicious, but sometimes they serve soggy pork cutlet... so I told you about it.
They say that it is natural for soggy pork cutlet to come out sometimes.
They are trying to teach me that every time the meat comes in, the quality may vary and sometimes it may be soggy.
It's a place where I've had good food so far. Tsk

Why do grandfathers refuse to admit their mistakes and try to discipline them?   Today, the meat was sliced ​​thinly on one side and thickly on the other.  The thin side was crispy, and the thick side was soggy. Sometimes, even when something was so soggy, I quietly told him about it, but today it was so bad that I told him about it.
Ah, shock... It's natural for something soggy to come out sometimes.  I can't help it... Hmm... That's sad... If I lower the temperature a little and increase the time a little, it won't come out so wet.   They ignore me, saying that even if I extend the time, it will never be solved.. Today I visited at 5 PM... I was the first customer after break time.  Since this is the first time frying after raising the temperature, there is a high possibility that the oil temperature is high, and if the outside of the meat cooks quickly and moisture cannot escape from the center, the pork cutlet will become soggy right after frying.    It's a simple principle, but why don't you know this? I was speechless when I heard that soggy pork cutlet was natural.

I complained because he tried to teach me too much.

If a regular customer says something nice, say sorry first and say you will be more careful in the future.  I've been preaching for a long time about saying this... Thanks to you, the soggy pork cutlet got cold... hahaha. I had a new experience...
Oh really... Older people can make mistakes... Why are they so bad at apologizing and so bad at serving customers?

As if he thought my sermon was correct, he said in passing that he was sorry in a low voice, but I felt sorry as if I had started a fight for no reason.

It was a place where good taste was served at an affordable price... I hope it goes well.
My advice isn't wrong, and since I've told you this much, I'm sure you'll try to fix it.  Well...

Although I can forgive the tasteless pork cutlet.  Soggy pork cutlet was something I couldn't forgive.

The photo is from February 22... It's hard to find because it's more than a year old.
It would be great if something so soggy and tattered didn't come out like this once every three or four times... Ugh...
Life is comfortable if you live without meddling with other people's food... These days, it's so hard to find food with sincerity, so sometimes I feel bad when a place I used to do well gets screwed, so I end up meddling.

reviews.text:
Possible configuration because it is Noryangjin

8-minute walk from Exit 3 of Noryangjin Station,
You can enjoy the ‘Cha Dong Set’, which includes chashu rice bowl and mini tonkotsu ramen, for 8,900 won.

Menu to enjoy without pressure
The mini tonkotsu ramen is suitable for people who like soup as the amount of noodles is about the size of a chopstick.
Even though it is mini-sized, it is quite filling as it also has chashu and egg toppings.
The soup is rather than a thick pork broth style.
It's clean and tastes like anyone can eat it without burden.
However, it was disappointing that the fishy aroma and taste of raw bean sprouts stood out slightly, perhaps because there was almost no pork smell.
It may be a bit boring for those who prefer a rich tonkotsu style, but it would be a suitable choice for those who like light soup.
I was satisfied that the char siu rice bowl had a generous amount of meat, allowing me to fully enjoy the taste of the meat.
The sauce was decent, so it was good to eat with rice.

#Forbidden City @ Noryangjin

Feeling resentful of the sweet, well-roasted, spicy soybean paste, I braved a snowstorm(?) and visited the Forbidden City, a cost-effective restaurant located deep in the alleys of Noryangjin. An elderly couple welcomes guests in a cozy manner, and snow begins to fall outside the window. It was possible to operate without a server through kiosks and tableware returns. I was worried about the dishes piling up because there was a constant flow of customers, but the restaurant runs very quietly and smoothly. The elderly couple held hands and feet in silence, and the food was cooked quickly and neatly. Customers who ate alone usually chose the half-and-half menu of noodles and sweet and sour pork, and even filled their stomachs with sweet and sour pork. This is a place where sweet and sour pork is tasty and cost-effective. The batter is crispy and hard, and is served in chunks. To compare the taste of soy sauce with black bean paste, I ordered both and tasted them, and they were clearly different. I recommend paying 1,000 won more and choosing Ganjjajang. Jjamppong soup is served, and the broth is refreshing. The seasoning seems to have been fairly restrained. As I finish emptying the bottle of Kaoliang wine, heavy snow is falling horizontally outside the window. I have yet to come across a spicy soybean paste. Should I go to Incheon?

reviews.author: A house that only tastes good
reviews.text:
Pizza specialty chain
Located a 2-minute walk from Exit 2 of Noryangjin Station.
A pizza set for one person costs 12,800 won.

1 person pizza competition
I was curious about the pizza I sometimes saw advertised at convenience stores.
The single-person pizza set consists of pizza, a side dish, and a drink.
There is also a set for 9,800 won,
Choose the basic pizza as a super combination
If you choose French fries as a side, it costs almost 13,000 won!
The price is a bit high for a solo meal.
One-person pizza sold at No More Pizza or Domino’s
It seems small in size and therefore poor cost-effectiveness.
This is a square style so it looks like there is more volume.
I don't know if the amount is actually larger, but
Visually, the square shape is a style I’ve never seen before.
It doesn't feel small.
There was no discomfort in eating.
The dough feels somewhere between basic dough and thin dough.
It has a slightly crunchy texture, which is good.
There are more toppings than expected, so it's enough for one meal.
Not bad if you like a strong tomato flavor.
The French fries ordered as a side menu were regular style French fries.

Store & Tips & Review
The store is small, but there are quite a few tables.
The long tables are set up for one person, so it's okay to eat alone.
Order and pay at the kiosk at the entrance.
Beverages are available in cans for delivery or packaging.
If eaten in-store, it is served in a cup from a vending machine.
Fortunately, the syrup wasn't weak so it was okay.
Still, it is better when drinks are served in cans.
When your pizza comes out, you pick it up at the counter, and there is a separate space to clean it up after you finish eating it.
Perhaps because the store was quite bright, it was disappointing to see a lot of bugs flying around.
I think I'll be particularly concerned during the summer.
